sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B Deployment Guide & API Specs | LLM API
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a 9B-parameter multimodal foundation model from Qwen that accepts both text and visual inputs. It is mainly used for general-purpose chat and reasoning tasks where developers want a capable but lightweight model that can run with lower latency and cost than larger LLMs.
